name: Corsair Gaming, Inc.
summary: Corsair Gaming, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, designs and sells gaming and streaming peripherals, components, and systems in Europe, the Middle East, North Africa, North America, Latin America, and the Asia Pacific. The company operates in two segments, Gamer and Creator Peripherals, and Gaming Components and Systems. The Gamer and Creator Peripherals segment offers gaming keyboards, mice, headsets, and controllers Stream Decks, microphones, teleprompters, audio interfaces, Facecam streaming cameras, studio accessories, command center displays, sim racing products, and gaming furniture.
